p: Witton Street is Northwich's main shopping street, and those black-and-white timbered buildings aren't just for show: many were built so they could be jacked up as the ground sank from salt mining underneath. This Admiral is one of the 18+ adult gaming centres in among them.

Salt made Northwich, and it's worth digging into that story. The Lion Salt Works at Marston, just outside town, is a restored open-pan salt works turned museum. The Anderton Boat Lift, a remarkable Victorian structure that lifts boats between the River Weaver and the Trent and Mersey Canal, is a short drive away and has boat trips and a visitor centre. Back in town, Barons Quay by the river has a cinema and places to eat, and the Weaver riverside is pleasant for a walk.
